title: ABRIDGED PERSONALITY NOTES FORM
text:
EXPLANATORY NOTES - ABRIGDED PERSONALITY NOTES FORM (AFTER TWO
(2) YEARS OF THE NIC’s APPROVAL)
Who should complete this Form?
1. The abridged form is to be completed by newly appointed Directors, Senior Managers or
Key Persons of regulated entities who have been previously approved by the National
Insurance Commission (NIC), but due to their acceptance of new appointment offers two
years after the NIC has granted them a no objection, they are required to undergo a new
vetting process.
2. Persons who occupied the Chief Executive Officers/ Managing Directors positions prior to
2017 and they have been presented again by another regulated entity for a position
specified in Section 55(1) of the Insurance Act 2021, (Act 1061).
What is the essence of this Form?
The purpose of this abridged form is for these nominees to provide any new updates regarding
the applicant that were not in existence during their initial fitness and propriety assessment
process. This includes, but not limited to, additional qualifications, changes in marital status,
additional employment history etc.
